title: Assistant’s Return Home
paragraphs: “Yeah… I really hope we find her, but more than that, I hope Sadeena-san can recover by then.”
I don’t think it’s just my imagination that Father’s eyes seemed to hold something different than before. Somehow, it reminded me of the Father from the first world.

He used to have that look in his eyes around the time Fohl’s sister died. After that, Father’s attitude softened a little, and it seemed like he deepened his trust with the villagers, the sister, and Filo-tan even more.
Father is growing in many ways. This must be a sign that he’s about to awaken to even greater strength. I must continue to strive as well.
“Well then, let’s get some rest. Good night, Motoyasu.”
“Good night, indeed.”
Father said he would rest on the sofa in the hallway to soothe the slaves who might cry in the night, while I returned to the presence of the glorious Filolials. The next day.
“We’re off now!”
Rival had both Assistant and Ren on her back, ready to depart. Her voice was loud, but her stance was a bit hesitant. In contrast, Assistant was quiet.
“Okay, take care. Ren, Wyndia-chan, Gaelion-chan, do your best.”
“Yeah.”
“I’ve made all the necessary preparations, so we’re ready. Now all that’s left is to train.”

Assistant seemed to be simulating various scenarios in her mind, as if she had a strategy prepared. She had ordered some equipment and tools from Ren. Is she planning to make something using the hero’s weapons? It also seemed like she intended to update her armor, weapons, and tools to some extent and buy additional supplies in the castle town.

Rival would only take them near the mountain, and once Assistant and Ren entered the mountain, she would switch to facing her parent. Is this going to be a match to see how long Assistant can hold out?

By the way, Assistant had been quietly focused on leveling up on Cal Mira Island and had improved her potential, so ordinary adventurers wouldn’t stand a chance against her. She might be chosen as a hero soon. That’s what Itsuki had recently mumbled, and it’s still fresh in my memory.
“I’ll be back in about three days.”
“W-Will it take that long? You could probably get to that mountain in half a day.”
“I’m being meticulous with traps and rituals… I’ll defeat Father for sure this time.”
With an ominous aura rising around her, Assistant responded. That was an ominous smile. Rival is the one who’s going to be on the receiving end of three days’ worth of prepared attacks, isn’t she?
“Gya—n-na, nano!”
Rival, on the other hand, was trembling. Was it her parent on the inside? Even Ren looked exasperated.
“Okay, we’re off.”
“Make sure to come back, nano!”
And so, Rival and Ren set off.
“Well then, I guess I’ll go around the neighboring countries’ slave traders today for the search… maybe.”
Father’s expression darkened. Then he went to the sister’s room to give her food and medicine. The sister’s cold had worsened, and now she had a high fever…
“I-I’m sorry—cough, cough!”
The sister tried to get up from the bed to respond to Father, but she kept coughing violently. Father stopped her and spoke.
“It’s okay, Sadeena-san. Just rest.”
“Cough—b-but, I feel bad—cough!”
Father placed the food on the table and helped the sister lie back down.
“Rest for now. If you’re like this, what will happen when we find Raphtalia-chan?”
“Oh… I guess you’ve got me there. Cough!”
The sister, looking much weaker than usual, complied with Father and lay down.
“Alright, today Motoyasu and I will do the searching. So just rest. If you take your medicine properly, you’ll get better soon.”
“Okay, okay.”
Father gave her the medicine. Thanks to the weapon’s effects, I assume it had quite a powerful healing effect on her. Her coughing stopped, but her complexion was still bad.
“Well, we’re off.”
“Take care…”
“We’re off, indeed!”

And so, Father and I went on our usual patrol of the neighboring countries’ slave traders. At the same time, we continued our search for the glorious Filolials. While we were moving, Father muttered softly.
“Sadeena-san… she was worse than yesterday.”
“That’s true. But since she took her medicine properly, won’t she get better?”
“Yeah, but… I just feel like the medicine isn’t working as well.”

“Father, you worry too much. This is the sister we’re talking about. If you give her some egg sake or something tonight, I’m sure she’ll feel better. She’s probably just feeling under the weather because she hasn’t had enough alcohol.”
“Like… if we put it in terms of someone like Itsuki with special abilities, it’s like she’s incredibly strong but needs to drink alcohol once a day as fuel, right?”
Oh, that’s not impossible at all. The sister must be a special ability user of that kind.
“Indeed. As far as I know, the sister always seemed to be slightly tipsy.”
“Haha, Sadeena-san was like that in the first world too. It’s nice… that she hasn’t changed.”
Father’s words somehow sounded dry to me.
“Naofumi, what are you talking about?”
Sakura-chan, who was giving us a ride, tilted her head. I was riding on Yuki-chan.
“We’re talking about wanting Sadeena-san to get better.”
“Yeah. Somehow… she’s not doing too well.”
“That’s true. Lately… it feels kind of gloomy. I hope we can do something about it.”
“Yes. A brighter atmosphere would be better!”
Yuki-chan also shared her opinion. Indeed.
“Alright, tonight I’ll make some egg sake with good liquor to help Sadeena-san feel better.”
“I’m sure the sister will get better with that!”
Father smiled warmly when he heard my words. That day, we found one of the village slaves. We also secured some Filolial eggs.
“We’re back…!?”
When we returned to the castle in Melromarc, the sister was playing tag in the castle garden with the rescued village slaves. Had she recovered?
“Uh, um…”
“Well…”
Even the village slaves seemed a bit fidgety.
“Sadeena-san! I told you to rest today!”
“Oh? I’m fine. Thanks to Naofumi-chan and everyone, I feel better.”
But before she could finish her sentence, the area around the sister’s chest twitched strangely. It looked like she was holding back a cough.
“Even if you try to act fine, it’s no good! Come on, take it easy!” Father spoke in a slightly scolding tone.
“Yeah. Please, rest.”
“Please.”
The village slaves also pleaded with the sister.
“Oh? Am I being left out? How lonely…”
“That’s not it. You’re still sick, and if you push yourself, you might spread it to these kids too.”
“Ehh, but…”
The sister swayed her body slightly, almost like a child throwing a tantrum. Father silently placed his hand on her forehead.
“See… you still have a fever. Go back to your room.”
“I won’t lose to a little cold!”
“Yes, yes. Alright everyone, I’m going to put Sadeena-san to bed. Motoyasu, please take care of everyone.”
“Understood!”
“I’ll help too!”
“Sakura will too!”
“Thanks, everyone. Now, Sadeena-san…”
“Boo… Sakura-chan’s imitation…”
“Yes, yes.”
And so, the sister was taken back to her room by Father.
